metadata.description: Vyomi, the local AWS / GCP / Azure simulator, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other coding agents.

plugins.name: vyomi
plugins.description: Run and test cloud code locally against Vyomi (Nano in the browser, or a Pro/Max mesh): scan a repo for AWS/GCP/Azure usage, see what is emulated where, wire SDKs to it, and add it to AGENTS.md. Needs vyomi-tunnel 1.3.0+.
